name: p2party
description: Protocol-v4 end-to-end encryption and reliable file transfer over a WebRTC room mesh

scripts.prebuild: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node scripts/emscripten.js && node scripts/updateWasmIntegrity.mjs
scripts.build:session: cross-env NODE_ENV=development P2PARTY_ROLLUP_TARGET=session rollup --config rollup.config.ts --configPlugin typescript
scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run build:package && npm run copy:wasm
scripts.predist: cross-env NODE_ENV=production node scripts/emscripten.js && node scripts/updateWasmIntegrity.mjs
scripts.dist:session: cross-env NODE_ENV=production P2PARTY_ROLLUP_TARGET=session rollup --config rollup.config.ts --configPlugin typescript
scripts.dist: npm run dist:worker && npm run dist:package && npm run copy:wasm
scripts.format: bun prettier --write '.github/**/*.{yml,yaml}' 'scripts/**/*.{js,mjs,ts,json}' 'examples/**/*.ts' '*.{json,mjs,ts}' README.md ROADMAP.md CHANGELOG.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 'docs/{getting-started.md,session-api.md,protocol-v4-security.md,references.md}' 'src/cryptography/{mnemonic.ts,random.ts,testModule.ts,wasmLoader.ts}' 'tests/cryptography/pake_ratchet.test.ts' 'src/handlers/{handleHandshake.ts,ratchetPersist.ts}' 'tests/handlers/handleHandshake.test.ts' src/index.ts src/session.ts && clang-format -i src/cryptography/mlkem*.[ch]
scripts.format:check: bun prettier --check '.github/**/*.{yml,yaml}' 'scripts/**/*.{js,mjs,ts,json}' 'examples/**/*.ts' '*.{json,mjs,ts}' README.md ROADMAP.md CHANGELOG.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 'docs/{getting-started.md,session-api.md,protocol-v4-security.md,references.md}' 'src/cryptography/{mnemonic.ts,random.ts,testModule.ts,wasmLoader.ts}' 'tests/cryptography/pake_ratchet.test.ts' 'src/handlers/{handleHandshake.ts,ratchetPersist.ts}' 'tests/handlers/handleHandshake.test.ts' src/index.ts src/session.ts && clang-format --dry-run --Werror src/cryptography/mlkem*.[ch]
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript-native7/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript-native7/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run example:standalone
scripts.gzip: npm run gzip:js && npm run gzip:worker && npm run gzip:wasm
scripts.integrity:js: openssl dgst -sha384 -binary lib/index.min.js | openssl base64 -A > lib/p2party.min.js.integrity
scripts.integrity:worker: openssl dgst -sha384 -binary lib/db.worker.js | openssl base64 -A > lib/db.worker.js.integrity
scripts.integrity:wasm: openssl dgst -sha384 -binary lib/libcrypto.wasm | openssl base64 -A > lib/libcrypto.wasm.integrity
scripts.integrity: npm run integrity:js && npm run integrity:worker && npm run integrity:wasm
scripts.prepare:uploadcdn: npm run gzip:js && npm run gzip:worker && npm run gzip:wasm
scripts.cleanup:uploadcdn: npm run gzip:cleanup && npm run integrity:cleanup
scripts.uploadcdn: npm run prepare:uploadcdn && npm run actual:uploadcdn && npm run cleanup:uploadcdn
scripts.preversion: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run example:standalone
